named-query.name: WeblogPermission.getByUserName
named-query.query: SELECT p FROM WeblogPermission p WHERE p.userName = ?1

named-query.name: WeblogPermission.getByWeblogId
named-query.query: SELECT p FROM WeblogPermission p WHERE p.objectId = ?1

named-query.name: WeblogPermission.getByUserName&WeblogId
named-query.query: SELECT p FROM WeblogPermission p WHERE p.userName = ?1 AND p.objectId = ?2
